blurb: Guests captain their own electric Duffy boats or pontoon boats to explore Newport Harbor. The company also offers a captained 30-foot tiki pontoon boat for private cruises. Rentals include fuel, safety equipment, a harbor map, and full orientation.
extraNote: Payment in full required at booking · Deposits refundable if made more than 7 days in advance; non-refundable if less than 7 days · No refund for no-shows or late arrivals; full fee charged · Speed limit in harbor is 5 MPH · No drugs or illegal substances allowed aboard · Located at Lido Marina Village docks, across from Lido House Hotel, near Via Oporto and Lido Village shops.
